page_topic_one_liner: Meta tags — title, description, robots, viewport, Open Graph, and 18 core HTML head tags for SEO and social sharing
differentiator_vs_generic: This is HTML head metadata and SERP snippet control, NOT GEO/LLM chat. Hero must be a syntax-highlighted `<head>` code panel with title, description, and robots tags, NOT an AI content generator or chat panel.
visual_anchors: HERO (~55% canvas): DevTools-style HTML `<head>` snippet — monospace panel with syntax-colored lines for `<title>`, `<meta name="description">`, `<meta name="robots">`, `<meta property="og:*">`, klein-blue highlight on description line
Secondary: mini SERP preview card showing blurred blue title link + grey description snippet beneath (meta-to-SERP mapping)
Tertiary: tag-type legend chips (SEO / Social / Technical) as torn stickers
anti_patterns: LLM chat panel as hero (this is meta tag SEO not GEO)
Generic `<>` brackets alone without head tag content
Social media feed UI unrelated to HTML metadata

en.headline: META TAGS
en.subtitle: Title, Description & Head Tags
en.composition: Visual-only editorial collage for meta tag guide. HERO: syntax-highlighted HTML head code panel occupying right two-thirds — visible title, description, robots, og:title/og:description lines with klein-blue accent on meta description row. Secondary: small SERP snippet preview mirroring the title/description. Tertiary: 3 tag-category sticker chips. Title block top-left only. Paper collage torn edges, halftone. NO LLM chat UI, NO OpenAI/Anthropic logos, NO real browser brand chrome, NO line numbers as dominant text.
